review_notes: Document review of identity, address, VDD and bus constraints only; not hardware qualification. Manufacturer-authored public distribution copies were downloaded, document numbers/revisions and cited sections inspected, and original bytes hashed. Single-byte combined register read is described in PS section 9.3, page 35. WHO_AM_I is read-only, not a FIFO or read-to-clear interrupt register. Module circuit and VLOGIC conditions remain deployment-specific. The 2026-11-27 extension also reviews RM 4.4, 4.5, 4.17-4.19 and 4.28-4.29 for fixed burst snapshots, current-range conversion and conditional SLEEP-bit clearing/restoration. Reads can acknowledge configured interrupts; explicit local plan approval is required for the entire sampling procedure. This is document review, not calibration or physical acceptance.
limitations: IC-level profile; breakout-board regulator, pull-ups, VLOGIC wiring and electrical compatibility are not inferred.
Identity match does not establish authenticity, measurement accuracy or healthy wiring.
Address and register-pointer selection involve bus writes within the approved read transaction; no configuration-register writes are authorized.
Unknown devices at the same address and concurrent bus users require deployment checks before a probe.
